thread:
sara: Heads up — while prepping AWS/GCP/Azure listings I hit a gap: the trial SKU needs delegated entitlements per cloud but the publisher console only supports single entitlement mapping. Anyone seen this? cc @ben-partnerships
ben-partnerships: Saw this on a gov-cloud listing last quarter. Suggest we split into SKU+offer level entitlement mapping as a workaround. Can product confirm this is acceptable?
amy-pkg: Product input — trials need to be per-tenant (not global). We can create SKU variants like `trial-us` and `trial-eu` but legal flagged duplicating EULA links as a potential issue. @venus-legal can you weigh in?
venus-legal: Legal: duplicating EULA links is fine if content identical, but must include region-specific tax/disclaimer language. Send a draft snippet and the manifest diff and we can pre-approve. Also need confirmation on data residency callouts.
mike: Infra/ops: for AWS AMI we already use `redwood-inference-vX-{{region}}`. If SKU variants are added we need explicit mapping entries in the listing manifest. I can update the manifest generator once we have the CSV mapping.
josh-sku: Started a mapping CSV (gist link): https://gist.github.com/xxxxx — cols: sku,offer,region,entitlement_code. Example row: `RINF-TRIAL,redwood-trial,us-east-1,ENT-TRIAL-001`. I also added `ami_id` and `publisher_role` columns for AWS.
sara: Perfect. Two asks from my side: 1) product to confirm variant approach is OK, 2) legal to provide a short region disclaimer snippet. Goal is to publish by EOD Wed to hit partner launch.
venus-legal: I'll draft the snippet by Tue EOD. Paste the tiny manifest diff here and I'll stamp it if it's just references.
ben-partnerships: I'll coordinate specifics per marketplace: AWS wants offer-level entitlement docs, GCP needs SKU metadata in the JSON metadata blob, Azure expects trial plan configs in the Publisher Portal. I'll make a checklist per cloud.
infra-bot: manifest-generator v2 deployed to staging at 2024-05-14T09:12Z — run `make manifest-test REGION=us-east-1` to validate regionized SKU mappings.
mike: Running tests now against staging. If green I'll open a PR with mapping + AMI refs.
amy-pkg: Product confirms variant approach. Caveat: analytics must unify trial SKUs so billing/usage dashboards roll up to a single trial metric. @sara please add `rollup_tag: trial` to the variants in the manifest.
sara: Yep — I'll add `rollup_tag: trial` and include rollout notes in #product after PR.
ops: FYI Azure publisher requires an Azure plan id for each trial variant — if we don't provide these it will block publishing. Ben, can you get provisional plan IDs from the partner portal?
ben-partnerships: On it. I'll request provisional plan IDs and share them here as soon as I have them.
venus-legal: Draft snippet (for manifest use): `By redeeming this trial you agree to Redwood's EULA (https://redwood.com/eula) and region-specific tax terms.` Happy to tighten language once I see the manifest reference.
josh-sku: Updated the gist: added `rollup_tag` and `eula_snippet_id` columns, pushed new version. Link: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx (updated).
sara: :thumbsup: OK team — action items list: ben = get plan IDs, venus = finalize snippet, mike = open PR for mapping, infra = validate manifest-generator on staging, amy = ensure analytics rollup tests. Ping me if blocked.
__note: This Slack thread documents coordination for cloud storefront SKU entitlement delegation and listing manifest changes across AWS/GCP/Azure. Short, operational thread with clear owners and next steps.
